acceptance: Start only after L12-MIN-INTEGRATE releases shared Compose/catalog ownership.
Wire scoped service URLs and non-embedded credentials for Agora handoff consumption and Consultation intake; no service may receive broader write authority than its endpoint requires.
Fail closed and report degraded when a token, upstream, tenant scope, or durable store is absent; never fall back to seed or anonymous cross-service access.
Expose bounded worker health/backlog/readback without making queue emptiness equal readiness.
Prove restart activation, credential rejection, tenant mismatch, upstream outage, and disabled-by-default rollback behavior.
Touch the loop catalog only if the runtime binding changes a declared contract; otherwise leave it byte-identical.
